mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the last month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the unemployment signal, or UNRATE increases do not correlate with subsequent GDP declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of periods with sustained HOUST increases, or HOUST increases do not correlate with subsequent GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply weakness signal, or INDPRO declines do not correlate with subsequent GDP declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the combined signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not predict negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in the last month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the labor market weakness signal, or PAYEMS declines do not correlate with subsequent GDP declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past two months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of periods with sustained RSAFS increases, or RSAFS increases do not correlate with subsequent GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising, the combination signals economic slowdown with tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: economic slowdown with tightening monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the combined signal, or the interaction of GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS does not predict negative returns.
